##### Project general facts

Marina Shores is a premium waterfront development located in Dubai Marina, offering refined living within one of the city’s most prestigious coastal communities. Rising 52 floors, the tower features elegant residences with unobstructed views of the sea and marina, as well as direct access to the vibrant Promenade, creating a seamless connection between tranquil living and urban energy.

The project offers a selection of apartments and duplexes, each designed to maximize panoramic views of the sea, Palm Jumeirah, and the surrounding marina skyline. The architecture and interiors reflect understated luxury, combining sophisticated design with a calm and contemporary aesthetic, making each residence a statement of refined taste and comfort.

The residences feature high-quality finishes and well-designed layouts that enhance space and natural light, with sea views available from every apartment. Kitchens are provided without appliances, and the units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to fully customize their living space according to their personal style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Marina is an iconic and prestigious waterfront community situated along the shoreline of Dubai. As one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods, it offers a captivating blend of urban sophistication, leisure, and breathtaking views.

The centerpiece of Dubai Marina is the man-made canal, which stretches over three kilometers and is surrounded by a collection of stunning high-rise buildings and luxurious waterfront residences. This vibrant development is known for its modern architecture and impressive skyline, making it a distinctive landmark in the city.

Living in Dubai Marina offers residents a lifestyle of convenience and luxury. The community is home to a wide range of amenities, including world-class restaurants, upscale shopping malls, and trendy cafes. The iconic Marina Walk provides a delightful promenade for leisurely strolls, with various dining and entertainment options overlooking the tranquil waters.
